name: io.github.obcraft/apiosk-mcp
title: Apiosk Connect
description: Ask a data question, review one plan and total price ceiling, approve in the chat card within your connected account's spending limits, and receive source-backed results. Resume without buying the same work twice.

environmentVariables.name: APIOSK_CONNECT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Apiosk agent token for stdio (apk_access_… from a connection, or a legacy apk_live_… agent key). Hosted MCP uses OAuth instead. Every tool acts for a connected account.

environmentVariables.name: APIOSK_GATEWAY_V2_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway v2 origin. Defaults to https://gateway.apiosk.com; set only for a local or staging gateway.
